limitations: SYNTHETIC set: invented documents, author-written claims and author-assigned expected statuses; not scientific validation.
Claims share vocabulary with the documents on purpose, because the verifier is lexical; accuracy here is an upper bound for how a lexical check behaves on clean text.

Statuses are lexical evidence-strength labels: a paraphrase is not connected to its source, swapped roles look identical, and 'reduced' vs 'eliminated' are not distinguished. Those cases are in the set (known_limitation) and are reported separately.
No real-source examples are bundled; none were fabricated. See datasets/verification_eval/README.md.
